ablations.name: No Novelty
ablations.ruling_rationale: Novelty prevents premature stagnation on multimodal problems; keep active.

ablations.name: No Crossover
ablations.ruling_rationale: Crossover enables recombining partial solutions; without it rediscovery rate drops.

ablations.name: No Neural Generator
ablations.ruling_rationale: Negative result validated: neural generator imposes 15-24% CVPS penalty without quality gain.

ablations.name: No Islands
ablations.ruling_rationale: Islands provide heterogeneous pressure and migration, accelerating convergence.

ablations.name: No Constant Optimizer
ablations.ruling_rationale: Discrete bank cannot fit arbitrary real coefficients (e.g. pi, 0.173); optimizer essential.

ablations.name: No Elite Memory
ablations.ruling_rationale: Integrity requirement: archive ensures persistence and reproducibility across restarts.

ablations.name: No Adaptive Mutation
ablations.ruling_rationale: Uniform point mutation cannot perform macro-structural changes; multiscale mutation needed.

ablations.name: No Cascade
ablations.ruling_rationale: Cascade eliminates 99%+ of dead candidates on 32 points, yielding >10x CVPS gain.

ablations.name: No Early Termination
ablations.ruling_rationale: Early rejection saves GPU execution slots by halting doomed programs at first invalid op.
